extName.description: Extension name. Product name, do not translate.

extDescription.message: Remplissez et copiez vos identifiants depuis Ashy Pass, le gestionnaire de mots de passe pour Linux.
extDescription.description: Extension description shown in the browser's extension list and in the store.

loading.description: Shown while the popup waits for the desktop app.

notInstalledTitle.description: Title when the desktop app (native host) cannot be reached.

notInstalledBody.message: Installez Ashy Pass et connectez ce navigateur dans Ashy Pass → Paramètres → Navigateur.
notInstalledBody.description: Explains how to connect the desktop app. 'Settings' and 'Browser' are the names of the app's settings page and section.

disabledTitle.description: Title when browser integration is disabled in the desktop app.

disabledBody.message: Activez l’extension du navigateur dans Ashy Pass → Paramètres → Navigateur.
disabledBody.description: How to enable the browser integration in the desktop app.

noVaultTitle.description: Title when the user has not created a vault in the desktop app.

noVaultBody.message: Créez d’abord votre coffre dans Ashy Pass.
noVaultBody.description: Asks the user to create a vault in the desktop app.

retryButton.description: Button that retries connecting to the desktop app.

lockedTitle.description: Title above the master password field.

masterPasswordLabel.description: Label of the master password field.

unlocking.description: Shown while the vault is being unlocked.

badPassword.description: Error after a wrong master password.

rateLimited.message: Trop de tentatives. Patientez un instant et réessayez.
rateLimited.description: Error after too many wrong master passwords.

searchLabel.description: Label and placeholder of the search field.

siteEntriesHeading.description: Heading of the list of entries that match the current site.

searchResultsHeading.description: Heading of the list of search results.

noEntriesForSite.message: Aucun identifiant enregistré pour ce site.
noEntriesForSite.description: Shown when no entry matches the current site.

noSearchResults.description: Shown when a search has no results.

notAWebPage.message: Le remplissage ne fonctionne que sur les pages web.
notAWebPage.description: Shown when the current tab is not an http or https page.

noUsername.description: Shown in an entry row when the entry has no username.

untitled.description: Shown in an entry row when the entry has no title.

fillButton.description: Button that fills the login form on the page. Keep it short.

copyUsernameButton.description: Button that copies the username. Keep it short.

copyPasswordButton.description: Button that copies the password. Keep it short.

copyCodeButton.description: Button that copies the verification (TOTP) code. Keep it short.

fillLabel.description: Accessible label of the Fill button.

copyUsernameLabel.description: Accessible label of the Copy user button.

copyPasswordLabel.message: Copier le mot de passe de $TITLE$
copyPasswordLabel.description: Accessible label of the Copy password button.

copyCodeLabel.message: Copier le code de vérification de $TITLE$
copyCodeLabel.description: Accessible label of the Copy code button.

usernameCopied.description: Short confirmation after copying a username.

passwordCopied.description: Short confirmation after copying a password.

codeCopied.description: Short confirmation after copying a verification code.

filled.description: Short confirmation after filling a login form.

noLoginForm.message: Aucun formulaire de connexion trouvé sur cette page
noLoginForm.description: Shown when the page has no field that can be filled.

copyFailed.message: Impossible de copier dans le presse-papiers
copyFailed.description: Shown when writing to the clipboard fails.

generateButton.description: Button that generates a new password and copies it.

generatedLabel.description: Label of the box that shows the generated password.

generatedCopied.description: Short confirmation after a password was generated and copied.

revealPassword.description: Button that reveals the generated password.

hidePassword.description: Button that hides the generated password again.

vaultLocked.description: Short confirmation after locking the vault.

errorTimeout.message: Ashy Pass n’a pas répondu à temps.
errorTimeout.description: Error when the desktop app takes too long to answer.

errorDisconnected.message: La connexion à Ashy Pass a été perdue.
errorDisconnected.description: Error when the connection to the desktop app closes.

errorNoMatch.message: Cet identifiant n’appartient pas à ce site.
errorNoMatch.description: Error when trying to fill an entry on a different site.

errorNotFound.description: Error when the entry was deleted.

errorNoTotp.message: Cette entrée n’a pas de code de vérification.
errorNoTotp.description: Error when the entry has no TOTP secret.

errorCannotAccess.message: Cette page n’autorise pas le remplissage.
errorCannotAccess.description: Error when the browser refuses to run the filler on the page.

errorDetail.description: Generic error with the English text sent by the desktop app.
